summary: The declared-API-surface reachability test names the endpoints deliberately dropped from this print (RSS feed, sitemap, anime streaming) instead of expecting them, so go test ./... is green without hiding the divergence.
reason: TestDeclaredAPISurfaceReachable asserted the spec-declared surface, but Phase 5 deliberately dropped three surfaces with a recorded cause in the acceptance report's Known Gaps: MyAnimeList serves the RSS feeds and sitemap as XML, which this client's JSON guard refuses, and /anime/{id}/streaming answers an invalid id with anime 1 rather than an error. The test therefore failed on a green print. The dropped paths stay in the expected list and in an explicit droppedSurfaces map with their reasons; the map is also used in reverse so a surface that starts shipping again fails the test as stale bookkeeping. Do not re-add the dropped endpoints to silence this, and do not delete the expectations.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli/ -run TestDeclaredAPISurfaceReachable passes; restoring any dropped endpoint turns the test red until it is removed from droppedSurfaces.
